name: Phone Build - Xbox
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  build-windows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
      - name: Setup Godot 4.2.2 with templates
        uses: solarlabyrinth/action-setup-godot@v2
        with:
          version: 4.2.2-stable
      - name: Export Windows build
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          godot --headless --verbose --export-release "Windows Desktop" build/HuntersWild.exe
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: HuntersWild-Windows
          path: build/
